index_scope.includes: recording, worker, native SNP/index, runtime job; excludes supervisors and outer controls

audit_scope.local: shared validate_stage/evaluate_cell plus direct numeric and typed inference counts, exact own/sham arrays and hashes; no independent neural recomputation
audit_scope.root_raw: shared stage-lineage guards plus independent 4626 rows, policy bindings, 40 SNPs, 16 strict core boundaries, inputs/identity and terminal process proof
audit_scope.root_outcomes: independent raw occupancy/gold, selection/inspection/timing/task and trajectory checks across all36 conditions

limitations: Four new development cells only; 20 of48 comparisons completed, remaining28 matrix cells and held-out scope open.
Fixed lower-route opportunity; only four core conditions are strict U-only, other five retain declared configuration/resources.
Both nulls falsely target one fact for seven selectors; confirmations are not stale-value corrections.
Lower changed fact corrected at358 in all nine; goal boundary identical within each cell, with no own-U timing/task benefit.
Source acquisition is explicitly privileged manual supervision; continuations are actual fixed CPU FLYNN policy.act.
No biological-learning, operator-blindness, held-out or R2-completion claim.
